snippet.title: LaserTank--Fun--Boot Camp
snippet.description:
Haven't played LaserTank for ages, but did so, with an easy game, some days ago. I should resume, as the logical and strategical thinking required seems to benefit my mind and brain. Sometimes when I am reading a book, for example, I can suddenly see a whole LaserTank game in my mind's eye, that I played ages ago--the whole bird's-eye view of the game, the patterns and everything. So I think LaserTank helps me to focus my mind in such a way that can be applied to the focus required for reading, and (is it) "higher order thinking", or something?

LaserTank is lots of fun, anyway, and a free game that can be downloaded online. Here are the details:

http://perso.cgocable.ca/lasertank/

Sorry I didn't get the sound to come across into the microphone from the laptop speaker very well. I'll have to figure out how to do it better, next time!

.....
